Troubleshooting · 09/50 · scheduling

Missing weather contingency

Failure signal

A missing weather contingency condition is reported or detected during scheduling.

Likely cause

The controlling record, technical state or approved specification for scheduling does not match the current asset or workflow.

Verification

Check thresholds for rain, wind, heat and daylight against forecast and equipment limits.

Corrective action

Activate a pre-approved cover set, indoor scene or reschedule trigger.

Prevention

Add this verification to the scheduling gate, retain immutable evidence and assign one accountable owner.
